text: Appeal of Order to Comply (November 30, 2018) for 5650 Sheppard Avenue East.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the order to Comply (November 20, 2018) for 5650 Sheppard Avenue East, Folder No.: 18 262791 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to May 1, 2019, in order for the area to be contained for health and safety reasons.
